title: Projectile Height vs. Time
summary: A line plot of projectile height (meters) versus time (seconds) for the sample function y = -x^2 + 4x across 5 exact data points from x = 0 s to x = 4 s. Height rises to a maximum of 4 m at 2 s and returns to 0 m at 4 s.

nodes.label: Point 3 (2 s, 4 m)
nodes.description: Peak height at Time = 2 s, Height = 4 m (exact).
